subject: computer-science
title: OSI and TCP/IP Models
welcome_lead: Stack up the network layers and route packets across the planet.
meta_desc: IBDP CS adventure on OSI 7 layers and TCP/IP 4-layer models.
final_note: Layered models split complexity into manageable jobs!

concepts.def: Four practical layers used on the internet.
Bits over wires, fibres or radio.
Frames on local segment; MAC addresses.
Packets and IP routing across networks.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application.

Mnemonic: 'Please Do Not Throw Sausage Pizza Away'.

Link, Internet, Transport, Application.

Maps to OSI: Link=PHY+DL, Internet=Network, etc.

Each layer adds its header to payload from above.

At receiver, headers are stripped on the way up.
